summary: Architecture planning is actionable with no material ambiguity. The implementation should proceed as a monorepo split into backend foundation, persistence/API, provider streaming, frontend shell/client/UI, mocked tests, documentation, and final verification. OpenRouter remains server-side, SQLite/sqlx owns local persistence, streaming uses SSE with no partial assistant persistence on interruption, and all automated tests must mock provider behavior.

proposals.title: Backend API and Persistence Spine
proposals.summary: Build the Rust 2024 Axum backend around explicit config, tracing, CORS, runtime SQLite migrations, structured errors, conversation/message repositories, and health/conversation/message routes before adding provider calls.

proposals.title: OpenRouter Proxy Behind a Mockable Provider Boundary
proposals.summary: Keep all OpenRouter communication in backend provider modules behind a ChatProvider trait, map missing key/rate limit/timeout/invalid payload/interrupted stream to stable application errors, and test provider behavior using mocks only.

proposals.title: Frontend ChatGPT-Style App Shell
proposals.summary: Create the Next.js App Router frontend with a responsive sidebar, transcript, composer, markdown rendering, TanStack Query cache orchestration, zod-validated API client, and native streaming fetch for SSE sends.

proposals.title: Mocked Verification and Documentation
proposals.summary: Add component tests, Playwright smoke tests with mocked backend and no OpenRouter requests, root README instructions, placeholder-only .env.example, and hygiene checks for secrets and generated artifacts.

risks.title: Provider calls leak to browser or tests
risks.impact: Secrets or quota could be exposed if frontend code calls OpenRouter directly or tests use live provider endpoints.
risks.mitigation: Keep OPENROUTER_API_KEY only in backend config, expose only NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL to frontend, mock all provider behavior in backend tests, and assert Playwright makes no OpenRouter request.

risks.title: Streaming persistence creates partial assistant messages
risks.impact: Interrupted provider streams could corrupt chat history by storing incomplete assistant responses.
risks.mitigation: Persist the user message before streaming, accumulate assistant deltas in memory, persist the assistant message only after provider completion, emit an SSE error on interruption, and test the failure path.

risks.title: SQLite transaction held across provider latency
risks.impact: Long provider calls can lock local persistence and create brittle timeout behavior.
risks.mitigation: Use short DB operations before and after provider calls, never hold a SQLite transaction while awaiting OpenRouter, and cover the ordering with persistence tests.

risks.title: Frontend and backend contracts drift
risks.impact: The UI may fail at runtime if zod schemas do not match backend response and error shapes.
risks.mitigation: Implement zod schemas from the backend DTO/error contracts, add malformed-response tests, and keep mocked Playwright fixtures aligned with those schemas.

claims.title: Backend-first API contract
claims.summary: Backend routes, DTOs, error shapes, and SSE event semantics should be stabilized before frontend streaming integration depends on them.

claims.title: Runtime sqlx queries
claims.summary: Use runtime sqlx queries rather than compile-time macros so a prepared database is not required for this generated repository.

claims.title: No live provider in automation
claims.summary: Automated backend, frontend, and Playwright tests must mock provider/backend behavior and must not call OpenRouter.

claims.title: Placeholder-only environment example
claims.summary: .env.example may document required variables but must not contain real keys or machine-local private configuration.

claims.title: Final readiness depends on full verification
claims.summary: Completion can only be reported after backend fmt/clippy/tests, frontend lint/tests/build/e2e, secret scan, generated-artifact scan, and CodeDungeon review/finalization evidence pass.

tasks.title: Scaffold backend runtime
tasks.objective: Create the Rust 2024 Axum backend crate with config defaults, tracing, CORS, router assembly, and health endpoint.
context: backend/ is the only server-side API surface
OPENROUTER_MODEL defaults to nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free
No OpenRouter call is needed for health
acceptance_criteria: Rust crate uses edition 2024 and builds as a backend service
GET /health returns service status without requiring OPENROUTER_API_KEY
Config applies the required default OPENROUTER_MODEL
CORS origin is configurable and tracing initializes without panics
risk_notes: Keep local .env loading runtime-only and do not commit secrets

tasks.title: Add SQLite persistence and conversation routes
tasks.objective: Implement sqlx SQLite migrations, pool setup, conversation/message models, and DB-backed conversation/message read routes.
context: SQLite is single-user local persistence
Tables are conversations and messages with UUID text IDs and UTC timestamp text
Conversation deletion should cascade to messages
acceptance_criteria: Runtime migrations create usable conversations and messages tables
Conversation create/list and message list endpoints persist and return expected DTOs
Malformed IDs return 400 validation_error and missing conversations return 404 conversation_not_found
JSON errors use the { error: { code, message, details } } shape
risk_notes: Use runtime sqlx queries to avoid requiring a prepared database

tasks.title: Implement non-streaming provider proxy
tasks.objective: Add the ChatProvider trait, OpenRouter non-streaming implementation, mocked provider tests, and POST message endpoint persistence.
context: OpenRouter calls must remain server-side
Chat send inserts the user message, calls provider outside a DB transaction, then inserts the assistant response after success
Provider failures need stable status codes and error codes
acceptance_criteria: Mocked provider success persists exactly one user and one assistant message
Missing key maps to 503 provider_not_configured
Rate limit maps to 429 provider_rate_limited
Timeout maps to 504 provider_timeout
Invalid provider payload maps to 502 provider_invalid_response
No automated test requires a real OpenRouter API key
risk_notes: Do not hold a SQLite transaction while awaiting provider responses

tasks.title: Implement SSE streaming message endpoint
tasks.objective: Add POST /api/conversations/:conversation_id/messages/stream with native SSE forwarding, assistant accumulation, completion persistence, and interrupted-stream handling.
context: Streaming endpoint forwards model deltas as SSE
Assistant text is persisted only after provider stream completion
Interrupted streams emit SSE error and avoid partial assistant persistence
acceptance_criteria: Streaming success emits assistant delta events and persists the completed assistant message
Interrupted stream emits an SSE error event and does not persist partial assistant text
Malformed stream requests reuse validation_error behavior
Provider stream tests use mocks rather than OpenRouter quota
risk_notes: Client disconnect behavior must not crash the Axum server

tasks.title: Scaffold frontend app and validated API client
tasks.objective: Create the Next.js App Router TypeScript Tailwind frontend with TanStack Query provider, zod schemas, backend client, and test harness.
context: Frontend uses only backend APIs
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL is safe to expose
API responses must be validated with zod
acceptance_criteria: Next.js App Router TypeScript project starts and builds with Tailwind configured
TanStack Query provider wraps the app
API client validates conversation, message, and error responses with zod
Malformed backend responses surface as app errors
risk_notes: Keep browser-exposed environment variables limited to NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL

tasks.title: Build responsive ChatGPT-style UI
tasks.objective: Implement the conversation sidebar, transcript, markdown assistant rendering, composer, loading states, error banner, and responsive mobile drawer behavior.
context: UI should present the actual chat application as the first screen
Assistant markdown uses react-markdown and remark-gfm
Components must avoid overlap on mobile and desktop

Composer blocks empty input and disables while sending
Transcript renders user and assistant messages with GFM markdown support
Unsafe raw HTML/script content is not rendered as executable markup

tasks.title: Connect frontend streaming send flow

Frontend should consume backend SSE only
Provider/backend/validation errors must be visible to the user

Validation/provider/backend errors re-enable composer and surface a useful error state

tasks.title: Add Playwright mocked smoke coverage
